svg.title: Two times per event, and processing in availability order
svg.desc: Flow A's first packet arrives at 0 milliseconds and it is still running at 10 milliseconds, so its event becomes available at 10 milliseconds. Flow B starts at 5 milliseconds and ends at 6 milliseconds, so its event becomes available at 6 milliseconds. A moving cursor shows time passing: packets appear as they arrive, B is processed at 6 milliseconds, before A, and A is processed at 10 milliseconds with B already in memory. When B is processed, A's packets after 6 milliseconds do not exist yet.
